mentions.name: Open-source SaaS for every vertical
mentions.description: This project builds open-source SaaS alternatives for business verticals. It has just launched an open-source Shopify alternative, with a Toast alternative for restaurants and a MindBody alternative for gyms planned next, and aims to leverage these platforms to build a decentralized marketplace around those verticals.
mentions.source_excerpt: we just launched our Shopify alternative. Next is Toast alternative for restaurants, MindBody alternative for gyms, etc. We’re going to leverage these platforms to build a decentralized marketplace around those verticals.
